question: Is each upgraded page genuinely source-supported, or only structurally enriched?
method: A page counts as source-supported only where at least one cited source passes all six evidence levels, which requires an independent attestation recording the passage read. Everything else is structural.

totals.finding: Four fifths of the upgraded corpus rests on sources nobody has opened. The uplift gave those pages the substantial shape using evidence their families already stored, which is a real improvement in what a reader can see, and is not the same as independently researched content.

tenHighestValueWeakest.reason: Its four sources declare boundaries but none has been inspected. Deepening requires reading them, which was not reached within this batch.

policy: No section was added to any of these pages. Adding structure to a page whose sources have not been read would raise its dimension count without raising what is known, which is the failure this assessment exists to name.
boundaryNotSubstituteForInspection: A declared source boundary tells a reader where that source stops. It does not tell them anyone read it, and it never advances the content-inspected level.
boundary: A private assessment. It changes no page.
